name: dota-den
description: Dota 2 companion: honest match and MMR tracking, Captain's Mode draft practice against an AI captain, live pro games with draft analysis, and hero meta. Next.js 16, TypeScript, MongoDB, OpenDota.

paragraphs: A Dota 2 companion for players who want honest answers about their own games, and a place to practise drafting that feels like a real captain across the table.
Production · Staging · Docs · Roadmap · Changelog · Decisions (ADRs)
features: Steam sign-in. OpenID with rotating, server-side sessions (ADR 0001).
Auto-synced match history. Imports your public matches (first sync backfills, later syncs are incremental), with
in-app match pages: scoreboard, gold and XP graphs, items, and every player's rank where known.
MMR journal. Log your MMR when you see it. A change is shown as exact only when two entries bracket exactly the

ranked games in between; otherwise it's labelled an estimate with the reason (ADR 0007). Climb by hero shows each hero's record and estimated climb game by game, exact only when your entries isolate games on that one…

whatItDoes.text: A Dota 2 companion for players who want honest answers about their own games, and a place to practise drafting that feels like a real captain across the table.

requirements.text: Sign in with Steam and Dota Den pulls your public match history from OpenDota, keeps it in sync, and turns it into pages you can actually use: your record and form, your heroes, who you play with, how your sessions went, what the latest patch changed for you.
Signing in locally needs a real Steam login at APPURL.
